{{Quote|OK, so if I cross-wire a DDX pulse modulator with the flux control module, maybe add in an integrated power flow control chip to the microprocessor, that should give me twice the power output with a &hellip; hmmm &hellip; 225.6 variance &hellip; uh, I'm sorry, did you say something to ''me?''|[[Madel Wharen]]|<ref name="Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref>}}
A '''microprocessor''' was a component. [[Madel Wharen]] once considered combining one with a [[DDX pulse modulator]], a [[flux control module]], and a [[power flow control chip]].
